faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Associate - I position at NIO?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Project Associate - I position at the National Institute of Oceanography is 13th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate - I role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc degree in Botany, Zoology, Bioinformatics, Marine Science (with specialization in Biology), Oceanography (with specialization in Biology), Marine Biotechnology, or Marine Microbiology, or an equivalent qualification. A NET/GATE qualification is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Project Associate - I position announced by the National Institute of Oceanography.

faq.question: Q4. What is the stipend offered for the Project Associate - I position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate - I position will receive a stipend of Rs. 31,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their filled application forms to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Does NIO provide any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limit or age relaxation details for the Project Associate - I position. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any such information.

faq.question: Q7. What kind of experience is preferred for this role?
faq.answer: Experience in handling sample collection in marine habitats, along with laboratory skills in Microbiology, Molecular biology, and Bioinformatic analysis, is preferred for this role.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the Project Associate - I recruitment. Candidates can proceed with their application without any fee.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be accessed through the links provided in the "Important Links" section of this article, which directs to the National Institute of Oceanography's official website.

faq.answer: The job type for the Project Associate - I position at the National Institute of Oceanography is project-based, indicating a temporary engagement tied to a specific research project.
